description: Tools required by the Assistant Trainer for building and managing agents, and for running the prompt-test suite against them

generate_agent_documentation.reason: Writes README to agent's own directory

create_agent_files.reason: Writes a new agent's manifest/prompt files to disk; queued for admin approval before it runs

delete_agent.reason: Deletes an agent directory and all its files

manage_prompt_catalog.reason: Edits the prompt-test catalog, which decides what the agents are measured against. Reading it is free; changing it is a judgement call worth confirming.

run_prompt_tests.reason: Makes real, paid LLM calls and replays prompts that can themselves write to the site.

analyze_prompt_results.reason: Read-only correlation of the catalog, the agent manifests and the tool registry.

manage_skill.reason: Writing a skill changes how an agent behaves from then on, so it needs sign-off — matching the floor Skills Assistant already carries.
